tagline: Local travel beyond Seoul, in the order that fits you, not the order ads pay for
sample_notice: Data from Korea Tourism Organization and SEMAS public data, with Google ratings. Some places may not have ratings or hours yet.
origin_current: Current location: your location (from your browser)
origin_outside: You are outside Jung-gu, Daejeon, so distances are measured from Jung-gu Office.
origin_located: Got your location. Distances will be measured from where you are (from Jung-gu Office if you are outside Jung-gu).
dong_filter_note: Showing {dong} only. Rank numbers are from all results.
no_results: No places match your filters. Try a longer distance or a higher budget.
diversity_note: {n} higher-ranked places share this main category, so the score was multiplied by 0.9^{k} (at most 0.9³).
neutral_note: No Google data, so a neutral value of 0.5 was used.
adjusted_rating_note: The fewer the reviews, the closer it is pulled to the site average ({c}) (m = 5).
login_to_review: Log in to write reviews and save places.
err_fields: Username must be 3+ characters and password 6+.
dashboard_free: Free visibility stats — no ad spend needed.
category_avg: Average views in the same category ({cat})
tip_no_views: No views yet. Adding a main photo and description helps you show up in searches.
tip_low_like_rate: Many views but few saves. Try improving your main photo and description.
tip_below_category: Views are below your category average. Add words visitors search for to your categories and description.
tip_foreign_majority: Most visitors are international. Consider English, Chinese and Japanese descriptions.
not_owner: Log in with a business account to view this.
footer: Trippin · SKKU Problem Solving and Computing, Team 13
category_only_note: Only places in the categories you chose are shown.
own_place_note: This is your own store, so you cannot review or save it, and your visits are not counted.
